hook: Steal the best text in the shop, on your board or across the fight, and become whatever tribe you're wearing.
loop: Take a Guise from the shop, a friend or the enemy
Keep or swap Guises, and Exchange units with the shop
Kept Guises and Exchanges pay permanent stats to every Changeling

growth.line: Small bodies grow each End of Turn for Guises kept, taken or Exchanges made; copied text does the rest.

feel.early: Borrow the shop's best When played text
feel.mid: Keep Guises or keep swapping; work the shop
feel.late: The Lady wears every Guise; the Fetch copies your carry

stars.why: Belly, Mire and Pass on one body: the two-tribe payoff
Moves a Guise onto what you take, tying Exchange to Guise
Steals and silences the enemy's key unit, read off their board

card_short.u01: When played: wears a shop unit's Guise; it fires too
card_short.u02: Wears a neighbour's Guise; grows each turn it keeps it
card_short.u03: When played: Exchange a friendly unit with the shop
card_short.u04: End of Turn: Changelings wearing a Guise gain stats
card_short.u05: Copies a friend's Guise with left/right and front/back swapped
card_short.u06: Start of Combat: wears the enemy across's Guise this fight
card_short.u07: Selling or Exchanging leaves a Stock wearing that unit's Guise
card_short.u08: Changelings gain stats whenever they take a Guise while recruiting
card_short.u09: Whenever you sell a unit, may take its Guise
card_short.u10: Wears two friendly units' Guises at once
card_short.u11: End of Turn: buffs one unit per tribe you have
card_short.u12: Start of Turn: may Exchange; the Guise moves to the new unit
card_short.u13: Exchange moves the old unit's buffs, plus +2/+2, onto the new
card_short.u14: Kept Guises pay stats each turn by the copied unit's tier
card_short.u15: Steals the enemy across's Guise; silences it if bigger
card_short.u16: Changelings' fight Guise triggers fire twice
card_short.u17: Wears every Guise your other Changelings wear
card_short.u18: Start of Combat: a Stock copies your biggest other unit
card_short.u19: End of Turn: Changelings gain stats per Exchange this game
card_short.x01: A blank 1/3 Changeling that can wear a Guise
card_short.x02: Spell: Exchange a friendly unit; any tribe can use it

builds.name: The Masquerade
builds.line: Wear a second tribe's best texts; the Lady holds them all

builds.name: Board of Exchanges
builds.line: Swap small units for the shop's best each turn; Bettie pays out

builds.name: Impostors
builds.line: Place Turncoat and Penny across the enemy's key unit; steal its text

liked: A Guise brings its tribe: a Changeling can fly south as a Bird
Exchange makes the shop a trading partner, which no other tribe does
worries: Keeper of the Lost Hour with the Lady doubles fights; Lady is hard to read
Bettie Underhill keeps climbing late; Midnight Swap gives any tribe a cheap unit
changed: Coat-Peg Steward moves stats instead of copying them, closing a buy-back loop
The Fetch now copies your carry's stats, text and Guises
Placement Officer moves a Guise onto the unit you take
verdict: Players who love borrowing other tribes' tricks get a game of stealing text and changing tribes.
